conditions.runtime: The standalone JEM Building mod is installed on both the logical server and participating clients.

change.summary: Add the standalone survival construction hammer and persistent hollow construction placeholders.

modifiers.after: A left-click radial menu selects wall, floor, 1x1 column, hollow sphere, or an open-ended hollow vertical cylinder. Right-click confirms against a block or live air target, with every axis bounded to 256 blocks, then incrementally populates persistent placeholders without forced chunk generation.
Confirmed placeholders are free, while every real block is placed through the held BlockItem and consumes its ordinary survival stack.

modifiers.before: Temporary construction placeholders persisted until manual cancellation or replacement.
modifiers.after: Each temporary construction region stores one seven-Minecraft-day expiry. A coarse server queue expires due regions without per-block polling, incrementally removes only remaining placeholders in loaded chunks, and leaves every real replacement block intact. Optional Jade presentation shows only one current unit: whole Minecraft days with a trailing plus for a positive remainder, then minutes during the final day, then seconds during the final minute.

rationale.purpose: Provide survival builders with persistent material-backed construction cells without a tier ladder, free blocks or private JEM dependencies.
rationale.decision_source: User supplied the Major Building and Quality-of-Life mission and explicitly assigned the standalone construction mod to its own Sandbox branch. Codex selected bounded region work, ordinary saved blocks and native BlockItem filling as implementation details.

introduced.summary: Add JEM Building as an independent Forge 1.20.1 construction mod.

history.summary: Keep JEM Building standalone while allowing JEM Compat to promote its builder hammer into native Handcrafted and BBB interactions and retire both legacy player-facing items.
Add a block-cell vertical cylinder whose circular side wall has no top or bottom caps, sharing the existing preview, persistence, filling, cancellation and expiry lifecycle.

Persist one seven-Minecraft-day deadline per region, process only due regions through a coarse server expiry queue without per-block tick scans, and expose the remaining lifetime through optional one-unit Jade presentation.
Give hammer cancellation one explicit owner, render sphere previews from shared block cells, and resolve column height from the cursor ray instead of direct pitch scaling.
Replace face selection with a four-mode radial menu, block-or-air confirmation, look-directed walls, 1x1 columns, hollow spheres, and 256-block bounds.
Add one hammer, three axis-aligned planes, hollow saved placeholders, cancellation and survival material filling.

relations: held BlockItem -> native placement and inventory consumption
jem_building:builder_hammer -> Handcrafted Hammerable.onHammer through JEM Compat
impacts.notes: JEM Building remains independently loadable. When JEM Compat, Handcrafted and BBB are present, JEM Compat adapts this item into their native interfaces without changing their registered block behavior.
unresolved: Runtime player acceptance and third-party claim-mod behavior were not exercised because the user prohibited all tests and validation runs.
